title: Universal keyless aimbot rayfield (pc only)
features:
An aimbot script in rayfield. Yuh. pc only, il make mobile ver in the future :)

Features:

Main aimbot:

Enable aimbot toggle

Activation Mode (hold and toggle)

Aimbot keybind

Aim smoothness (lerp) (0.05 to 1 speed) (recommend 1 for instant shot)

Circle & colors:

Toggle show fov circle

Fov radius (30 to 400 px)

Circle thickness (1 to 6 px)

Circle hex colour (idle) (sets to hex colour)

Circle Hex colour (locked) (sets circle colour when activated by trigger)

Targeting & Filters:

Target body part (changes aimbot to player body part, HumaniodRootPart, Uppertorso, Head.)

Team check (makes the aimbot doesn't target your teammates if the game have teams in leaderboard.)


Prediction & Lead:

Auto Ping Based Prediction: (automatically reads your real time ping ms nd scales the aimbot lead time to make your shots align whenever latency spikes.)

Air-shot / jump prediction: (checks the target state jumping or falling and automatically applies an extra prediction multiplier to catch's the target being a kangaroo...etc)

Bullet drop/ gravity offset: (calculates the distance from you to the target to adjust your aim upward, for gravity over long distances aka makes your shots more accurate)

Custom Bullet speed slider: (no, it doesn't change your bullet speed, the script calculates your bullet speed by studs then the aimbot can use it as an advantage to shoot players more accurate by gravity [paired by bullet drop / gravity offset])

Base lead Multiplier Slider: (controls the prediction for how many milliseconds or seconds for ground targets)

Yey! Prediction & lead is a new feature i made. My script is now version 1.2! thanks for using my script :) bye bye :D

Thats all :) also it may be detected as it uses camera which some games powerful anti cheat can detect. Try it with caution! (Im ensure not rlly all games you play can detect it except rivals its detected.)

Works on low end executors that support rayfield such as xeno and solara)

-- hi! The script has pcall. Bye! 
--owner: zin1213455 (in scriptblox)
-----------------------------------------
local success, response = pcall(function()
    return game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/SEa2d1e5")
end)

if success then
    local compiledFunc, syntaxError = loadstring(response)
    if compiledFunc then
        local runSuccess, runError = pcall(compiledFunc)
        if not runSuccess then
            warn("Script ran into an error while executing:", runError)
        end
    else
        warn("Syntax error in Pastebin code:", syntaxError)
    end
else
    warn("Failed to download script from Pastebin:", response)
end
